name: Script loads and creates AIDRPG through input
description: Confirms the script loads, the input hook runs, and state.aidrpg exists.
whyItMatters: If this fails, no later system testing is meaningful.
patchHint: Inspect the Library shell and CoreState initialization.

name: Context hook returns text
description: Confirms context building can run after a normal input.

steps.text: The player is in a stone room.

whyItMatters: Context is the immediate AI-facing truth layer. If this breaks, the AI cannot see current state properly.

name: Output hook runs without crashing
description: Confirms output processing can run on normal prose.

steps.text: You search the guard and find nothing unusual.

whyItMatters: Most persistent consequences are handled in Output. Output crashes make gameplay unsafe.
patchHint: Inspect Output processing order and any newly added processOutput methods.

name: Debug commands do not crash
description: Confirms core debug commands return readable text.
whyItMatters: Debug commands are how the tester and user inspect the system while building.
patchHint: Inspect AdminDebugSystem and the specific formatter that failed.
